Tool: Claude Opus 4.5, Lecture: Lecture 6

Goal:

The goal of this is to turn the handwritten lecture notes into a complete, step-by-step “textbook chapter” without skipping any content using a structured system prompt. The prompt forces the LLM to rewrite every equation and symbol, explain every concept in plain English, and derive formulas line-by-line.

Evaluation:

Did Well

Captured the full narrative flow of the lecture, connecting disparate topics 

Gave clear intuition for difficult math

Rarely skipped topics touched on in the notes

Limitations

Occasionally summarized text blocks instead of rewriting them verbatim 

Mixed external knowledge into the notes without always clearly labeling it 

Sometimes invented small details to make the narrative smoother

Prompt: https://drive.google.com/file/d/11pExwTIi11A0ssL2ztrrajsW3Qx9z87d/view?usp=sharing

LLM Trace: https://claude.ai/share/4993f343-6808-4e3c-8c5f-314f3d094867
